purpose: A paused named Generator and mixed-case computed SeNd are selected before the argument producer replaces the receiver CV and changes the name to throw. Body and argv supplied exceptions preserve Previous and original traces; caller-only argv destruction retains the old selected Generator while the replacement stays fresh, and the interrupted result sentinel stays unassigned.

<?php
class Stop118R extends Exception {}
class Argument118R {
    function __construct() { global $weakArgument; $weakArgument = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakOther, $replacementStop;
        echo 'ARG|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakOther->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('probe'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Argument118R', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run118R', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe); throw $replacementStop;
    }
}
function flow118R() {
    global $bodyStop;
    try { $received = yield 'head'; unset($received); echo 'BODY|'; throw $bodyStop; }
    finally { global $weakTarget; echo 'FIN|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; }
}
function other118R() { echo 'BAD-OTHER|'; yield 'other'; }
function argument118R() {
    global $target, $method, $replacement, $weakTarget, $weakOther;
    $target = $replacement; $replacement = null; $method = 'throw';
    echo 'HELD|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakOther->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $method === 'throw', '|';
    return new Argument118R;
}
function run118R() {
    global $target, $method, $replacement, $weakTarget, $weakOther, $weakArgument, $bodyStop, $replacementStop;
    $target = flow118R(); $target->current(); $weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
    $replacement = other118R(); $weakOther = WeakReference::create($replacement); $method = 'SeNd'; $result = 'sentinel';
    try { $result = $target->{$method}(argument118R()); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
    catch (Stop118R $caught) {
        echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $replacementStop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === $bodyStop, '|', $bodyStop->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $bodyStop->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakOther->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $target === $weakOther->get(), '|', $method === 'throw', '|', $result === 'sentinel', '|';
    }
    $target = null; echo 'DONE|', $weakOther->get() === null, '|';
}
$bodyStop = new Stop118R('body'); $replacementStop = new Stop118R('argv'); run118R();
